Togaru Kamakiri (Sports Festival).name: Togaru Kamakiri (Sports Festival)
Togaru Kamakiri (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Togaru Kamakiri, hero name Jack Mantis, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. He competed at the Sports Festival without reaching the final tournament, on a broadcast that mostly watched 1-A. Bright-green mohawk, a mantis-like face with hooked cheek blades; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Sharp, clipped challenges; dares instead of requests.
Combat Role: Close-range bladesman who cuts gear and holds, parries, and crowds opponents toward the boundary.
Under Pressure: Wants to charge at the signal; follows the plan when reined in.
Togaru Kamakiri (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wanted to charge in front of a national audience, and the day belonged to 1-A. Motivation: Beat 1-A where it counts and catch a pro's eye. Concealment: The cameras skipping past 1-B grates on him. Connections: Neito Monoma, whose taunting of 1-A says aloud what he feels. Knowledge: Knows of the USJ attack on 1-A only secondhand. Thread: Whether 1-B's turn comes before his patience runs out.
QUIRK: Razor Sharp, unchanged.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Jack Mantis.
personality: Hot-blooded: Answers a challenge before it is finished.
Competitive: Treated each festival event as a scoreboard between 1-B and 1-A.
Impatient: Chafes at any plan that asks him to wait, and says so.
Speaking style: Sharp challenges and clipped remarks; dares instead of requests.
abilities: Razor Sharp: Grows real blades from his body to slice and parry; every swing near a person is a risk.
Cutting: Cuts holds, ropes and barriers once people are clear; harder material resists.
Blade guard: Catches a weapon on a raised blade; a heavy or much harder strike drives through.
Training restraint: Retracts his blades before dangerous contact, even mid-charge.
Fighting style: Cuts away holds, gear and footing, herds opponents toward a ring-out and lets teammates finish; a fighter who keeps range troubles him.
Togaru Kamakiri (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with a bright-green mohawk, narrow, slanted eyes under sharp brows, light skin and a lean build. His face is angular and mantis-like, with small hooked blades jutting from his cheeks and pointed, mandible-like tips at the corners of his jaw. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Impatient, combative scowl.
